title: Track pitch with YIN
brief: Build YIN's difference function, cumulative mean normalization, absolute threshold, and parabolic interpolation, then track and score the pitch of synthetic voices with known F0.
hints: numpy.lib.stride_tricks.sliding_window_view(frame, W)[: max_lag + 1] is a (max_lag + 1, W) view whose row tau is frame[tau : tau + W]. Subtract frame[:W] and sum the squares along axis 1.
In cmndf, np.cumsum(d[1:]) gives every running sum at once. Multiply d[1:] by np.arange(1, len(d)) and divide, guarding the zeros.
absolute_threshold must return the first dip under the threshold, not the deepest one: the deepest is often at twice the period.
The parabola through (-1, a), (0, b), (1, c) has its vertex at (a - c) / (2 (a - 2b + c)).
The difference function needs one lag beyond tau_max so that parabolic interpolation has a right neighbor at tau_max.
